title: Disperse both velocity polarisations using the exact Leray-projected ladder
statement: For inviscid w_tau=P[(a*cos(2pi*p.x).grad)w], a.p=0 gives the exact frequency ladder d_tau w_j=i*pi*(a.k)*P_(k+jp)(w_(j-1)+w_(j+1)); its bounded generator is skew-adjoint in the divergence-free ell2 subspace. As N->infinity, noncentral projections approach P_m and the two polarisations split into scalar Jacobi chains with central bonds1 and tau=|k.m|/(|k||m|), tau^2>=r. Their central atom-free density is rho_tau(lambda)=tau^2*sqrt(4-lambda^2)/(pi*((1-tau^2)^2*lambda^2+tau^4*(4-lambda^2))) on(-2,2). Endpoint splitting/integration by parts bounds the return amplitude by2sqrt(h0)/r+50/(r^3*h0^2*|z|). With h0=(r*eps/16)^2 and the chosen s, it is<=eps/4. Finite-N projector error<=10R/(N|m|) and unitary Duhamel error<=160sAR^2/N add<=eps/4; every low input mode returns at most eps of its amplitude at its original frequency. No scalar-transport commutation of Leray projection is assumed.
